expected_symptom: A single IDxcCompiler/IDxcCompiler3::Compile call given -Fc <file> yields no disassembly listing to the caller -- no DXC_OUT_DISASSEMBLY on the result and no file written. Today the argument is rejected outright: the call returns S_OK but the result status is E_INVALIDARG (0x80070057) with the error text: Unknown argument: '-Fc'. Suppressing that with -Qunused-arguments makes the compile succeed and ignore -Fc silently.
godbolt_skip: Compiler Explorer runs dxc.exe, the command-line driver -- which is the ONE caller that already handles -Fc (it parses with DxcFlags = CoreOption|DriverOption). This issue is about IDxcCompiler/IDxcCompiler3::Compile, which parse with CompilerFlags = CoreOption alone; CE cannot call the compile API at all. A link would therefore demonstrate the opposite of the finding. The equivalent contrast is captured locally instead, in manual-case-cmdline-vs-api.txt (dxc.exe writes repro-fc.asm, 4103 bytes; the API answers E_INVALIDARG and writes nothing), and the API side is measured across 21 releases in manual-case-release-history.txt.
history: always-repro'd -- identical on all 21 cached releases v1.4.1907 (2019-07-15, predating the issue) through v1.9.2607 (2026-07-29) and on main; -Fc has carried Flags<[DriverOption]> with no CoreOption since 6ee4074a4 (2016-12-28, first commit), per git log -L 505,505:include/dxc/Support/HLSLOptions.td. bisect deliberately NOT run: it drives each release's dxc.exe, the one caller that DOES handle -Fc, so it would score every release no-repro. See manual-case-release-history.txt.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.6-sol (SKILL.md step 10 initial and final-draft reviews, applied selectively at collation)
summary: Unimplemented, exactly as filed. -Fc is Flags<[DriverOption]> only (HLSLOptions.td:505); dxc.exe parses with DxcFlags = CoreOption|DriverOption (dxclib/dxc.cpp:1437) while the library parses with CompilerFlags = CoreOption alone (dxcompiler/dxcutil.cpp:114), so in the API path -Fc becomes OPT_UNKNOWN and ReadDxcOpts fails the parse (HLSLOptions.cpp:534-537); dxcutil::ReadOptsAndValidate builds a finished DxcResult carrying E_INVALIDARG and both entry points return S_OK with it (dxcompilerobj.cpp:562-566, :1908-1911). Measured with a committed C++ harness (fc2604.cpp) against dxcompiler.dll: 10 cases, both interfaces, DXIL and SPIR-V, 21 releases + main -- identical throughout. IMPORTANT for a prospective PR: adding CoreOption to -Fc is NOT the fix. opts.AssemblyCode has no reader anywhere under tools/clang/tools/dxcompiler/ (git grep exits 1 there, 10 hits repo-wide), and no Compile path produces DXC_OUT_DISASSEMBLY -- the only producer is Disassemble (dxcompilerobj.cpp:1386), as dxcapi.h:381 documents. That patch would convert a loud failure into a silent one. Separable finding: docs/SPIR-V.rst:4197-4198 claims the listed options are also recognized by the library API calls, and :4211 lists -Fc; measured false on every release, including with -spirv. That doc text (8702f97df 2017, 474954a6e 2018) predates the issue and fully explains the 2020 comment. Issue text is accurate and not stale; the 2024 maintainer position still holds.
title: Handle -Fc in Compile API
